_lisezmoi: One record per airline. Every size, weight and fee read on the airline page listed in sources (see params-2026.json), on readOn; via = wayback when the Internet Archive copy of the airline page was read. Inches for US airlines, centimetres for UK and European airlines, as published.

airlines.name: American Airlines

personal.note: Must fit under the seat in front of you. No weight limit stated.

carry.note: The carry-on page states 1 personal item and 1 carry-on with no Basic Economy exception; no carry-on weight limit stated. American Eagle regional jets: larger bags are valet-checked free at the gate.

checked.note: domestic US (within/between U.S. incl. HI/AK, Puerto Rico, USVI), Main Cabin; online = paid on aa.com/app up to 2 h before departure

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card: first checked bag free for eligible cardholders on domestic American-operated itineraries (AAdvantage number must be in the reservation). Number of companions covered is not stated on this page.
perks.status: AAdvantage Gold / oneworld Ruby: 1st bag free; Platinum / oneworld Sapphire: first 2 bags free; Executive Platinum, Platinum Pro / oneworld Emerald: first 3 bags free.
perks.military: Active U.S. military with ID on personal travel: first 3 checked bags free; on orders (and dependents): 1st-5th bags free.

airlines.changes: Main Cabin domestic 1st bag $40 -> $50 ($45 online) and 2nd bag $50 -> $60 ($55 online) for tickets issued on/after April 9, 2026; 3rd bag $150 -> $200 from April 9, 2026; Basic Economy pays $5 more (1st $55/$50 online, 2nd $65/$60 online) for tickets issued on/after May 18, 2026.
airlines.notes: aa.com returned HTTP 403 to automated requests; read from Wayback captures (checked/carry-on 2026-07-13, oversize/overweight 2026-02-28 — the latter page said fees updated Feb 20, 2024 for travel on/after April 17, 2024). Overweight/oversize 'from/to' bounds are our integer reading of 'over 50-53 lbs' etc.

airlines.name: Delta Air Lines

carry.note: 1 carry-on + 1 personal item free for every passenger (Delta Main Basic included). Delta Connection flights with 50 seats or less: personal items only on board, larger bags gate-checked free. No weight limit stated.

checked.note: domestic US, Delta Comfort and Delta Main (no online/airport price difference published)

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card: first checked bag free for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation (when the flight is booked with the card); the basic cardmember also gets a second checked bag free on domestic Delta-operated flights.
perks.status: Medallion members (any tier) and SkyTeam Elite/Elite Plus: first checked bag fee waived, extended to up to 8 companions on the reservation; more bags depending on tier/fare.
perks.military: Active U.S. military: personal travel 2 free bags in Delta Main/Comfort (3 in Premium Select/First/One); on military orders 5 free bags.

airlines.changes: Domestic fees rose for tickets purchased on/after April 8, 2026: 1st bag $35 -> $45, 2nd bag $45 -> $55 (Delta 'Previous Checked Baggage Fees': 'Within the United States — Ticketed before April 8, 2026 — Increased fees for the 1st bag from $35 to $45; Increased fees for the 2nd bag from $45 to $55').
airlines.notes: Fare names now 'Delta Main', 'Delta Comfort', 'Delta Main Basic'. Delta One/Delta First get 70 lb per bag. No personal-item dimensions published.

airlines.name: United Airlines

personal.note: United writes it as 9 in x 10 in x 17 in.

carry.note: Basic Economy: personal item only on most trips (carry-on allowed only to South America, transatlantic, transpacific); a carry-on must be checked for a fee: from $50 in the airport lobby and $75 at the gate for tickets purchased on/after April 3, 2026 ($40/$65 before). Exempt: MileagePlus Premier members and those traveling with them, primary cardmembers of a qualifying co-branded card, Star Alliance Gold.

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card: fee waivers exist for cardmembers (and qualifying primary cardmembers may bring a carry-on in Basic Economy); the free-checked-bag details (number of bags, companions) are not on the pages read.
perks.status: MileagePlus Premier: the member and up to nine others on the same itinerary check bags free; economy within U.S./Canada/Mexico/Caribbean/Central America: Silver 1 bag, Gold 2, Platinum 3, 1K 3 (70 lb each).
perks.military: U.S. military personal travel: 3 free bags (62 in, 70 lb); on military orders: 5 free bags (115 in, 100 lb).

airlines.changes: Bag fees for domestic flights (and U.S.–Canada/Caribbean/Mexico, short Latin America) increased for tickets purchased on or after April 3, 2026; Basic Economy checked-carry-on fee now from $50 lobby / $75 gate (was $40/$65).
airlines.notes: united.com refused automated connections; read from Wayback captures of 2026-10-11. 2nd/3rd bag, overweight and oversize dollar amounts are shown only by United's JavaScript bag-fee calculator, so they are null.

airlines.name: Southwest Airlines

carry.note: Carry-on + personal item free on every fare, including Basic. Help-center wording: 24” (length) × 16” (width) × 10” (height), wheels/handles included.

checked.note: U.S. Mainland, Basic/Choice/Choice Preferred fares, booked/ticketed/changed on or after April 9, 2026 (Choice Extra: 2 bags free)

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card: first standard checked bag free for the primary cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation (Rapid Rewards number must be in the booking).
perks.status: A-List Preferred: 1st and 2nd bags free (+ up to 8 passengers on the reservation); A-List: 1st bag free (+ up to 8 passengers).
perks.military: Active-duty military with valid military ID: 1st and 2nd checked bags free.

airlines.changes: For U.S. Mainland travel booked/ticketed/changed on or after April 9, 2026: 1st bag $35 -> $45, 2nd bag $45 -> $55. Interisland Hawaii (non-residents): $15/$20 -> $30/$40.
airlines.notes: Help-center pages (support.southwest.com) are JavaScript-rendered; they were read with WebFetch on 2026-10-26 (via 'live'), not with curl.

airlines.name: Alaska Airlines

carry.note: Carry-on free for all traveler types incl. Saver fares (fee table: Carry-On = Free).

checked.note: North America, Main Cabin and Saver, flights ticketed on or after April 10, 2026

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card: one free checked bag for the cardholder and up to 6 guests on the same reservation when the airfare is bought with the card.
perks.status: Atmos Silver / oneworld Ruby: 1st bag free; Gold / Sapphire: 2 bags; Platinum & Titanium / Emerald: 3 bags (status-holder companions on the same reservation included).
perks.military: Active-duty U.S. military with ID, leisure travel: 1st-3rd bags free up to 70 lb (up to 5 at 70 lb); with orders: also overweight/oversize charges waived up to 5 bags.

airlines.changes: For flights ticketed on or after April 10, 2026: 1st bag $40 ($35 prepay) -> $45, 2nd $45 -> $55, 3rd/4th+ $150 -> $200; the $5 online pre-pay discount no longer appears.
airlines.notes: Fee table is in the page's embedded JSON (rendered client-side); quotes are table rows joined with ' | '. Intra-Hawaii fares differ ($30/$40/$50).

airlines.name: JetBlue

personal.note: Dimensions stated in the U.K./Europe paragraph of Flights Terms; the domestic paragraph gives no personal-item size.

carry.note: All fares (including Main Base, the former Blue Basic) include a carry-on and a personal item.

checked.note: within U.S./Latin America/Caribbean/Canada, Main Base/Main/EvenMore, off-peak; 'online' = added more than 24 h before departure, 'airport' = Contract of Carriage charge for tickets bought on/after March 27, 2026 Weight: less than 51 lb (Contract of Carriage).

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit cards (two tiers): first checked bag included for the cardmember and up to three travelers on the same itinerary, JetBlue-operated flights only.
perks.status: Mosaic 1: 1st bag included; Mosaic 2-4: 1st and 2nd bags included (for the member and travelers on the same itinerary).

airlines.changes: Contract of Carriage (2026-06-01 revision): 1st bag $49 and 2nd bag $69 for tickets purchased on or after March 27, 2026; 3rd+ bag up to $200 for tickets purchased on or after April 17, 2026. Fare 'Blue Basic' renamed 'Main Base' on jetblue.com.
airlines.notes: Online (advance) vs. within-24h pricing: the fees page shows the advance price with the saving included; the within-24h price equals the CoC charge ($49/$69 off-peak). Military free-bag policy not found on the pages read. CoC PDF read via Wayback (2026-10-14); PDF text extraction splits some words, quotes are normalised.

airlines.name: Frontier Airlines

personal.note: One personal item included with all fares, checked at boarding.

carry.note: Carry-on is paid unless included in a bundle (Economy, Premium, Business bundles) or Elite Gold+; price varies by travel dates and when purchased (cheaper at booking than at the airport).

perks.status: Elite Silver: personal item; Elite Gold: carry-on (member only); Elite Platinum: carry-on + 1 checked bag (member + up to 8 on the same reservation); Elite Diamond: carry-on + 2 checked bags (member + up to 8).
perks.military: Active U.S. military with CAC/military ID (and accompanying spouse/children on the same itinerary): one personal item, one carry-on and two checked bags free, overweight/oversize fees waived on the two free bags.

airlines.changes: Overweight 51-99.99 lb fee $100 -> $129 for bookings made on or after April 4, 2026 (41-50 lb remains $75).
airlines.notes: Checked-bag standard limit is 40 lb (bags of 41-50 lb pay $75). A co-branded card free-bag benefit is not stated on the pages read.

airlines.name: Allegiant Air

personal.note: Free; Allegiant writes 8 in. x 14 in. x 18 in.

carry.note: Carry-on always paid: $10.00 to $75.00 depending on route and when added. Allegiant writes 10 in. x 16 in. x 22 in.

airlines.notes: allegiantair.com returned HTTP 403; read from Wayback capture of 2026-09-30. Checked max size is 80 linear inches (not 62). Gate-checked bags $0.00 to $75.00; oversized personal item at airport $50.00 to $75.00.

airlines.name: Hawaiian Airlines

carry.note: Carry-on free for all traveler types (fee table: Carry-On = Free).

checked.note: North America (incl. mainland–Hawaii), Main Cabin and Saver, flights ticketed on or after April 10, 2026

perks.card: Airline co-branded credit card (Hawaiian Airlines card): 2 free checked bags for the primary cardmember only, on North America–Hawaii and interisland flights; the Atmos Rewards card gives 1 free bag for the cardholder and up to 6 guests on the same reservation.
perks.status: Atmos Rewards status (shared Alaska/Hawaiian program): Silver 1 bag, Gold 2, Platinum/Titanium 3. Hawaii residents: Huaka'i program (interisland bags free).
perks.military: Same as Alaska: active-duty U.S. military with ID get 1st-3rd bags free up to 70 lb.

airlines.changes: Same shared table as Alaska: for flights ticketed on or after April 10, 2026, 1st bag $45, 2nd $55, 3rd $200 (North America).
airlines.notes: Old hawaiianairlines.com/our-services/baggage/* URLs now return 404; Hawaiian now publishes the shared Alaska/Hawaiian baggage page (identical content to alaskaair.com).

airlines.name: Spirit Airlines

personal.note: Free with every fare; must fit under the seat.

carry.note: Value travel option: no carry-on, can be purchased (price per flight at booking). Premium Economy and Spirit First options include a carry-on.

perks.military: Service members (and accompanying spouse/children) with valid military ID: one free standard carry-on and two free standard checked bags; must be added online in advance.

airlines.notes: spirit.com and customersupport.spirit.com did not respond on 2026-10-26 (connection dropped); Wayback captures of content.spirit.com after 2026-10-11 return HTTP 502. Data from Wayback: Bag Info article (2026-05-02) and Contract of Carriage 'updated as of April 30, 2026' (capture 2026-10-08). Check Spirit's operating status before publishing.

airlines.name: Ryanair

checked.note: 20 kg and 23 kg hold bags; no item over 32 kg or 81 × 119 × 119 cm is carried at all

range.item: 10kg Check-in Bag bought at airport bag drop (not pre-booked)
20kg Check-in Bag bought at airport bag drop (not pre-booked)

airlines.carryNote: Priority & 2 Cabin Bags add-on; included in Regular and Flexi Plus (and Plus tickets bought before 11 Dec 2019)

excess.quote: Excess Baggage Fee Per Kilo n/a €/£13 The price at the airport/call centre/kiosk is €/£13 per extra kilo.

gate.quote: Passengers who bring an oversize bag (over 55x40x20cm) to the boarding gate will either have their bag refused or, where available, placed in the hold of the aircraft for a fee of €/£70.00 - €/£75.00. [...] Non-priority customers who bring their 10kg check-in bag to the boarding gate will either have their bag refused or, where available, placed in the hold of the aircraft for a fee of €/£46.00 - €/£75.00.
gate.note: Terms add '(plus VAT on domestic flights)' to the €/£70-75 gate fee.

airlines.notes: No 2026-dated baggage change found on the pages read. Fee ranges are official min-max per flight; exact price is shown at booking.

airlines.name: easyJet

checked.note: hold bags of 15, 23, 26, 29 or 32 kg; total size under 275 cm

range.item: Large cabin bag at the boarding gate
Hold bag at bag drop desk (not pre-booked, up to 23kg)

airlines.carryNote: paid 'large cabin bag' add-on (includes Speedy Boarding); free for easyJet Plus members; included on Inclusive Plus fare (subject to locker space)

excess.where: airport (hold items heavier than pre-booked weight)
excess.quote: Excess weight fee per kilo, per item, per flight £12 This fee is applied for hold items weighing more than the pre-booked weight. The maximum weight per hold item we can accept is 32kg.

gate.quote: It’s always cheaper to add a large cabin bag online than at the boarding gate, where it costs £60.

airlines.notes: No effective date for the power-bank ban is shown on the page. Small and large cabin bag both 15kg max per easyJet pages.

airlines.name: Jet2

checked.note: 22 kg hold bags; no general hold size published

airlines.carryNote: all fares (free, excluding infants); 'Guaranteed Cabin Luggage' is a paid add-on to keep it in the cabin on busy flights
airlines.notes: Jet2 includes 10kg hand luggage on every fare. Fees null: priced per flight at booking and official fee page not reachable.

airlines.name: British Airways

checked.note: 23 kg in Economy and Premium Economy, 32 kg in Business and First; no hold bag on Economy Basic

airlines.personalNote: all fares incl. Economy Basic (hand baggage only)
airlines.carryNote: all fares including Economy Basic (hand baggage only)
airlines.changes: Page banner 'Update to our power banks policy' (no effective date stated): power banks and spare batteries forbidden in checked baggage.
airlines.notes: BA is a full-service carrier: hand bag + cabin bag free on all fares; heavy bag fee 65 GBP. Extra-bag prices only via calculator/booking.

airlines.name: Wizz Air

excess.quote: Weigh your bags before you arrive, as a ‎13 EUR/kg surcharge will be due at the airport if your bag weighs between 10 kg and 20 kg or between 20 kg and 32 kg.

airlines.notes: Wizz help pages still show a 40x30x20 cm free bag; some booking-flow strings on the same site mention 42x32x25 cm, not used here (help-centre allowance page is authoritative).

airlines.name: TUI Airways (tui.co.uk)

checked.note: 20 kg on most packages, 25 kg on some; no bag over 25 kg accepted

range.item: Flight-only checked bag (15kg), Cape Verde, Egypt, Gambia, Senegal or long-haul

airlines.carryNote: all TUI Airways customers aged 2+ (flight-only and package)

excess.quote: Short and mid-haul flights (less than seven hours) - £15 per additional kilo [...] Long-haul flights (over seven hours): - £20 per additional kg

airlines.notes: Charges may vary by season per TUI page.

airlines.name: Virgin Atlantic

checked.note: 23 kg in Economy Classic and Delight; no checked bag on Economy Light

airlines.carryNote: all Economy (Light, Classic, Delight) and Premium tickets; Upper Class 2 pieces (12kg each, 16kg combined)
airlines.notes: All Virgin Atlantic figures come from mid-2025 Wayback captures; flag as unverified for 2026.
